correctness.rationale: Inspected Behzadipour original Theorem 1.5 (same definition) and independently derived T=(σ(n)−1)/2−n=p(h−(p+1)/2)+h−1 with h=2^a. For p<h set A=h−(p−1)/2 in [0,h−1], B=h−1−p even in [0,h−1]; pA+B=T and binary powers p2^i plus 2^i(i≥1) are distinct valid proper divisors. For p>h, if p≥2h+1, T<0; if h<p≤2h−1, T<p² excludes p²-divisor layer. Any remaining subset sum is pC+D with D even, 0≤D≤2h−2, D≡h−1 mod p; only candidate h−1 is odd, contradiction. p=h impossible for odd p. Finite bitset examples corroborated proof, not substitute for it.
